            <div class="timeline-meta">Internship · May 2026 - Present · Ile-de-France, France · On-site</div>
            <p><strong>ML-focused clinical decision support:</strong> focused on Bayesian modelling for Predictive Probability of Success (PPoS) and ML acceleration strategies for go/no-go decisions under uncertainty.</p>
            <p><strong>Context:</strong> clinical drug development is long, costly, and uncertain, and early positive evidence does not always translate into Phase III success, especially in oncology where endpoints, populations, and trial designs differ between phases.</p>
            <p><strong>Problem statement:</strong> teams need fast and transparent answers to core questions: what is the probability of success of a future or ongoing trial, should development continue, and how should Phase II evidence be transferred to Phase III decisions when endpoint definitions change (ORR, PFS, OS) and designs differ (single-arm vs randomized controlled).</p>
            <p><strong>Development-process focus:</strong> this work is positioned at the critical Phase II to Phase III decision point in the broader sequence Phase I → Phase II → Phase III → Regulatory Review, where quantitative evidence must support resource allocation and risk decisions.</p>
            <ul>
              <li>Built models linking Phase II evidence to future success probability in Phase III across continuous, binary, and survival endpoints.</li>
              <li>Worked on the transition challenge between differing trial designs and endpoint structures between development phases.</li>
              <li><strong>Machine Learning contribution:</strong> proposed and implemented an XGBoost surrogate with Bayesian optimization to learn complex relations between PoS and trial parameters, enabling rapid large-scale scenario simulation instead of long MCMC runtimes for every exploration workflow.</li>
              <li>Contributed to the design and deployment of a decision-support application so teams can run robust, reproducible assessments without direct model coding.</li>
              <li>Combined methodological rigor and operational usability to support fast clinical strategy discussions.</li>
            </ul>

<script>
  const menuToggle = document.getElementById('menuToggle');
  const mobileDrawer = document.getElementById('mobileDrawer');
  const drawerBackdrop = document.getElementById('drawerBackdrop');
  function toggleDrawer(force) {
    const open = typeof force === 'boolean' ? force : !mobileDrawer.classList.contains('open');
    mobileDrawer.classList.toggle('open', open);
    drawerBackdrop.classList.toggle('open', open);
    menuToggle.setAttribute('aria-expanded', open ? 'true' : 'false');
    document.body.style.overflow = open ? 'hidden' : '';
  }
  menuToggle?.addEventListener('click', () => toggleDrawer());
  drawerBackdrop?.addEventListener('click', () => toggleDrawer(false));
  document.addEventListener('keydown', (event) => { if (event.key === 'Escape') toggleDrawer(false); });
</script>
